Hi Johannes :)
Since no one was charging I started v7.0.5
There is a known issue with EcoG 1.4.5 which shows the error "c
ould not configure local station for slac
" which can only be seen via WebUI. I forgot that you have those permissions.
If I find another l will show you how it looks so that next time you can do it yourself :)
Please monitor if the update is done and we can rollout v8.0.5 immediately too. I will try to proactively check it as well.
Thanks!
best regards,
Francisco
